operations.name: get_brand
operations.summary: What Outshot knows about the brand: product, audience, content themes, tone.

operations.name: list_videos
operations.summary: The videos waiting for a decision, oldest first. With a key that can make changes, reading it also asks for new videos when fewer than the target are waiting, as opening the app does (10 credits each, 15 for a Demo video).

output_schema.description: The videos waiting for a decision, oldest first, and how the deck stands.
output_schema.title: VideoList

operations.name: get_video
operations.summary: One video as it is now. Use it to follow a change until its state is ready.

operations.name: list_calendar
operations.summary: Kept and posted videos, by posting day, with their TikTok links once posted: those still to come, and those of the last 30 days (past_days to go further back).

past_days.description: Also the videos whose day was up to this many days ago (posted, or not). Those still to come are always there.
past_days.title: Past Days

CalendarItem.description: A kept video on its posting day (the app's Calendar).
CalendarItem.title: CalendarItem

output_schema.description: Kept and posted videos, by posting day.
output_schema.title: Calendar

operations.name: list_content
operations.summary: Every video the brand kept, posted or skipped, each in its group: ready (kept with no day yet; or `missed`: its time passed without posting, or its send stopped midway), scheduled, posted, skipped (kept 30 days, until `deletes_on`).

ContentItem.description: A brand's video in Content: kept (with a day or not yet), posted, or skipped.
ContentItem.title: ContentItem

output_schema.description: Every video the brand kept, posted or skipped lately.
output_schema.title: ContentList

operations.name: get_credits
operations.summary: The credit balance, the plan, and what each thing uses.

operations.name: get_posting
operations.summary: The posting days, the time and time zone videos post at, whether kept videos take the next open day by themselves (auto_schedule), and whether they post to TikTok by themselves.

operations.name: list_trends
operations.summary: The Library: trending TikToks the brand's videos are made from (how each is built, its reach), saved ones first. `makes`: what make_video_from_trend would make from it.

format.description: Only trends built one way: slideshow, wall_of_text, hook_plus_footage or meme.
format.title: Format

TrendMakes.description: What "Make a video from this" makes from the trend: its kind, and what it costs.
TrendMakes.title: TrendMakes

output_schema.description: The Library: saved trends first, then the weekly plan's order.
output_schema.title: TrendList

operations.name: list_demos
operations.summary: The product demos (screen recordings) that Demo videos are made with.

Demo.description: A product demo. `status`: uploaded, normalizing (being made ready), ready or failed.
Demo.title: Demo

operations.name: update_brand
operations.summary: Change the brand's goal, tone, audience, words to avoid, or content themes. New videos follow the changes.

answers.description: The goal, tone, audience and words to avoid.

pillars.description: The content themes; at least one.
pillars.title: Pillars

operations.name: skip_video
operations.summary: Pass on a waiting video. A new one is made in its place (10 credits each, 15 for a Demo video).

operations.name: undo_video
operations.summary: Take back a decision: a skipped or kept video goes back to waiting.

operations.name: edit_video
operations.summary: Change a video's words. Changing the caption or hashtags is free and immediate; changing words on screen remakes the video.

input_schema.description:
The words to change (only fields sent change). On-screen words remake the video;
the caption and hashtags are stored at once.

text.description: The words on screen (meme and wall_of_text videos).
text.title: Text

demo_caption.description: The line over the demo (Demo videos).
demo_caption.title: Demo Caption

caption.description: The post's caption. Free, and changed at once.
caption.title: Caption

hashtags.description: Hashtags, without #. Free, and changed at once.
hashtags.title: Hashtags

input_schema.title: EditWords

output_schema.description:
A change to a video. `queued`: the new version is being made; follow it with
get_video until its state is `ready`.
output_schema.title: Change

operations.name: swap_media
operations.summary: Swap one picture or clip in a video for the next pick, and remake it.

slot.description: What to swap. meme: meme_clip or background; wall_of_text: broll or music; hook_demo: opener or music; slideshow: images (with slide).
slot.title: Slot

slide.description: For a slideshow: which slide, from 0.
slide.title: Slide

output_schema.description:
A change to a video. `queued`: the new version is being made; follow it with
get_video until its state is `ready`.
output_schema.title: Change

operations.name: regenerate_video
operations.summary: Make a video again from the same trend, with new words and media.

output_schema.description:
A change to a video. `queued`: the new version is being made; follow it with
get_video until its state is `ready`.
output_schema.title: Change

operations.name: remove_closer
operations.summary: Remake a Demo video without its closing reaction.

output_schema.description:
A change to a video. `queued`: the new version is being made; follow it with
get_video until its state is `ready`.
output_schema.title: Change

operations.name: set_posting_days
operations.summary: Choose the days that get a video (one video a day). Kept videos stay on their day.

days.description: The days that get a video: mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun.
days.title: Days

operations.name: update_posting
operations.summary: Change the posting days, auto-schedule, the time or the time zone. Kept videos keep their day; a new time moves the ones still to come to it.

input_schema.description: What to change (only what's sent changes).

days.description: The days that get a video: mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun.
days.title: Days

auto_schedule.description: true: each kept video takes the next open posting day by itself. false: kept videos wait with no day until one is given (place_video).
auto_schedule.title: Auto Schedule

time.description: When videos post, HH:MM on the quarter hour, in the brand's time zone. Videos still to come move to it, on their own day.
time.title: Time

time_zone.description: The brand's time zone, like Europe/Paris or America/New_York.
time_zone.title: Time Zone

input_schema.title: PostingChanges

operations.name: answer_missed
operations.summary: Say whether a `missed` video (list_content) is on TikTok: its time passed without posting (posted by hand?), or its send stopped midway. Yes: it's marked posted; no: it waits in ready for a new day.

posted.description: true: it was posted by hand on its day (it's marked posted). false: it wasn't (it waits in Ready, with no day).
posted.title: Posted

output_schema.description: A brand's video in Content: kept (with a day or not yet), posted, or skipped.
output_schema.title: ContentItem

operations.name: create_demo_upload
operations.summary: Add a product demo: a 5 to 20 second screen recording. Gives back where to upload it.

Demo.description: A product demo. `status`: uploaded, normalizing (being made ready), ready or failed.
Demo.title: Demo

output_schema.description:
The new demo, and where to send its video: PUT the file's bytes to `upload.url`
with its `content_type`, then call complete_demo_upload.
output_schema.title: DemoUploadStarted

operations.name: complete_demo_upload
operations.summary: Say a demo's video is uploaded. It's checked and made ready in the background. The brand's first demo then gets a Demo video made with it (15 credits).

cut.description: Longer than 20 seconds: keep the first 20.
cut.title: Cut

output_schema.description: A product demo. `status`: uploaded, normalizing (being made ready), ready or failed.
output_schema.title: Demo

operations.name: set_demo_line
operations.summary: Say what a demo shows. Demo videos made with it follow the line. With the brand's first demo, a Demo video is then made with it (15 credits).

line.description: What the demo shows, in a few words.
line.title: Line

operations.name: make_video_from_trend
operations.summary: Make a video now from a trend in the Library: it's first in the deck (list_videos) in about half a minute. A trend built around a hook becomes a Demo video when the brand has a demo.

output_schema.description: The video is being made: it's first in the deck (list_videos) in about half a minute.
output_schema.title: MadeFromTrend

operations.name: set_demo_rhythm
operations.summary: How many Demo videos a week (0 to 3).

operations.name: delete_demo
operations.summary: Delete a product demo. It can't be undone.

operations.name: approve_video
operations.summary: Keep a video: it takes the next free posting day (with auto_schedule off, it waits in ready with no day). With TikTok connected it then posts there by itself on that day, with the brand's saved TikTok choices. With a key that can also make changes, a new video is made in its place (10 credits each, 15 for a Demo video).

operations.name: schedule_video
operations.summary: Set a kept video, made before TikTok was connected, to post to TikTok by itself on its day, with the brand's saved TikTok choices. Only one waiting to be posted by hand whose time is still ahead: one whose time has passed may already be on TikTok.

output_schema.description: A kept video on its posting day (the app's Calendar).
output_schema.title: CalendarItem

operations.name: place_video
operations.summary: Give a kept, skipped or unposted video a day, or move one to another day (one video a day; swap to trade days with the video there). No day: the next open posting day. With TikTok connected it then posts there by itself, with the brand's saved TikTok choices.

input_schema.description: The day to give a video. No day: the next open posting day.

day.description: The brand's own date (YYYY-MM-DD), from tomorrow on, or today while its posting time is at least 30 minutes away. Left out: the next open posting day.
day.title: Day

swap.description: When another video has that day: swap the two (only for a video that has a day of its own). Otherwise a taken day is refused.
swap.title: Swap

input_schema.title: PlaceDay

output_schema.description: A brand's video in Content: kept (with a day or not yet), posted, or skipped.
output_schema.title: ContentItem

operations.name: post_video_now
operations.summary: Post a kept, skipped or unposted video to TikTok now (it goes out within 15 minutes), with the brand's saved TikTok choices. TikTok must be connected.

output_schema.description: A brand's video in Content: kept (with a day or not yet), posted, or skipped.
output_schema.title: ContentItem
